item.title: How the Japanese locations in 'Rental Family' became more characters in the film
item.description: From city streets to historic restaurants to a unique digital art museum, the locations in "Rental Family" tell even more of the story. The film, starring Brendan Fraser, is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Some President's House exhibit panels back up as legal fight continues
item.description: Crews with the National Park Service began reinstalling some of the panels on Thursday, returning portions of the exhibit above the former slave quarters.

item.title: More on the Presidents House Slavery Exhibit
item.description: This Sunday, Host Sarah Bloomquist and the Panel discuss the President's House Slavery exhibit re-installment, Philadelphia City Council hearings on the proposed school district changes, and Mikie Sherrill's New Jersey Congressional Seat

item.title: Philadelphia City Council approves three year ban on backyard breeding
item.description: City officials have advanced new restrictions aimed at curbing unregulated breeding.

item.title: Firefighter, 3 others injured in Easton, Pa. blaze
item.description: Firefighters say when they arrived, several people were hanging from windows, trying to escape the smoke.

item.title: Student walkout in Quakertown ends in arrests after confrontation with police
item.description: In the footage, a man wearing a brown shirt, identified by sources at the Quakertown Police chief's office, is seen putting a girl in a chokehold as other students surround him.

item.title: South Jersey residents scramble for salt as another snowstorm approaches
item.description: Hardware stores that typically keep rock salt and ice melt in stock are now facing shortages, leaving customers hoping to secure what remains before the next storm arrives.

item.title: 2 children hospitalized after fire in Philadelphia's Olney neighborhood
item.description: Two children were rushed to the hospital following a fire in Philadelphia's Olney section.

item.title: AccuWeather: Winter Storm Watch for Sunday into Monday in the Philadelphia region
item.description: It's a nice start to the weekend with some sun returning Saturday, ahead of accumulating snow Sunday into Monday.

item.title: Uncertainty after Trump announces new tariff plan
item.description: Trump said he would impose a 10% global tariff for 150 days under Section 122, a provision designed for emergency situations.
